scoring_justification: Compute-driven DFT workflow; final values are reported by the agent and compared against paper gold; structural energy ordering check ensures the ground state is correctly identified.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for ground state, band gap, oxygen moments, relative energies
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 row ZO(3,6) and text: ground state AFM-G, band gap 155.2 meV, Bader moments 0.11-0.31 μB, relative energies NM=0, AFM-LR=-92.10, AFM-G=-96.03 meV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted verbatim from the paper as published.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual reported numbers for the same system and conditions; they are not invented by the solver or the verifier author.

outputs.description: Hidden checker compares ground_state_configuration to the paper's ground state, band_gap_meV within a tolerance, oxygen moment min/max within tolerances, and verifies AFM-G energy is lowest among all computed configurations (excluding NM=0).

output_contract.notes: Only the ZO(3,6) structure is required. Configurations that did not converge may be represented by null in relative_energies. The checker will validate that AFM-G has the lowest total energy among the converged magnetic configurations.
